preconditions.description: The number of people on the network excluding Bob must be between 1 and 500,000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= a_i <= n for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each person's friend count must be a non-negative integer not exceeding the total number of people.
The length of the list of friend counts must match the number of people specified.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if not any_valid_solution else True
postconditions.description: If no valid solution exists, output -1.
If valid solutions exist, output all possible values of Bob's friend count in increasing order.
